title: Influence of irradiance and drone altitude in infrared thermography inspections of photovoltaic plants
mechanism: Controlled drone IR of 43 artificially degraded modules at 4 altitudes and 200 to 1000 W/m2 to measure which faults are thermally visible.
evidence: R: cracked modules hard to distinguish from healthy; interconnect breaks visible from 600 W/m2; PID and glass cracks no pronounced anomaly; diodes and heavy soiling 80 to >100 C even at 200 W/m2; altitude effect small. Data public (our A3, CC BY 4.0, E).
adaptation: Cross-plant test set for any thermal classifier trained on PVF-10 / ISM, and the only public place where drone IR and EL meet on the same induced faults.
min_experiment: Resume pick 1 R1 / R2 / R3b as frozen in handbook doc 22 section 11: IR screening recall by fault type on A3; CPU only.
prior_overlap: A3 downloaded and verified; sunlit arm R1 / R2 / R3b and pick3b not run (doc 22). Open.
